rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; Not executable: the reply fails validation (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/f8889.deepseek.json`, state invalid: f8889.line3 "model changed a published result type", NonNegDollars for the published Dollars), so triage runs none of its lines: the declaration is adjudicated, not the tax reading. By reading: (1) without the last-month rule it always uses the monthly worksheet, so it ignores rule 4 for a filer eligible all year who changed coverage (i8889 p. 4, Line 3, rule 4: "If you were, or were considered, an eligible individual for the entire year and you changed your type of coverage during the year, enter on line 3 (see (6) in this list) the greater of: a. The limitation shown on the last line of the Line 3 Limitation Chart and Worksheet (in these instructions), or b. The maximum amount that can be contributed based on the type of HDHP coverage you had on the first day of the last month of your tax year", and its TIP, "If you had family coverage on the first day of the last month, you do not need to use the worksheet; enter $8,550 on line 3"). The classm.s2.2 taxpayer (eligible 12 months, family coverage 10 months and on December 1, rule not used) gets $7,841.67 where the project and the TIP give $8,550.00. (2) Under the rule it takes the December 1 maximum alone, reading 1 of amb.2025.hsa_last_month_change (not chosen). (3) It reads "married" from the filing status and adds the $1,000 for the self-only months of a married filer with family coverage in other months, against the Note (i8889 p. 5, Line 3, Note: "If you are married and had family coverage at any time during the year, the additional contribution amount is figured on line 7 and is not included on line 3").
